properties.description:
SVRFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Coconino County in north central Arizona...

* Until 1130 PM MST.

* At 1102 PM MST, a severe thunderstorm was located near Mormon Lake,
or 18 miles southeast of Flagstaff, moving north at 40 mph.

HAZARD...Quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Damage to vehicles is expected.

* Locations impacted include...
East Flagstaff, Mountain View Ranches, Cosnino, Winona, Mormon
Lake, Lakeview, Country Club, Walnut Canyon National Monument,
Fisher Point, Mormon Mountain, Upper Lake Mary, Marshall Lake,
Perry Lake, Ashurst Lake and Lower Lake Mary.

This includes the following highways...
Interstate 40 between mile markers 200 and 214. U.S. Highway 89 near
mile marker 419. Route 66 between mile markers 200 and 204.

This includes the following recreation areas and campgrounds...
Dairy Springs Campground, Double Springs Campground, Ashurst Lake
Campgrounds, Pine Grove Campground, Forked Pine Campground, Dairy
Springs Campground, Double Springs Campground, Lake View Campground,
Lakeview Campground, Foxglenn Park, Bushmaster Park and Fort Tuthill
County Park.
properties.instruction:
Seek shelter inside a well-built structure and stay away from
windows. This storm is capable of producing large hail.

Torrential rainfall is also occurring with this storm and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.

* WHERE...South Central Inyo County in south central California...

* WHEN...Until 145 AM PDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1046 PM PDT, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated

expected to begin shortly in the advisory area. Up to 0.5 inches

Weather Service when you can do so safely.
